div.head: JOSÉ JESUS PEREIDA.
div.p:
Thereupon, In obedience to subpoena, appeared before this court the young man, José Jesus Pereida, who being duly sworn stated, that his name is as above written; is fifteen years of age; bachelor; farmer; native and resident of Nacozari. Being examined as to the parts in the communication of the commissary of police of Nacozari,
and in the affidavit of his father, Manuel, concerning him, which parts were read to him, he testified that the statements of both are correct, that on the 17th of last December an American force under command of Captain Emmet Crawford, composed of 40 packers and 100 so-called tame Chiricahua Indians, passed through the mining town of Nacozari, and that on their way they fired upon the cattle encountered by them, killing and wounding 8 head of cattle, property of the following: Of José M. Torres, 1 mortally wounded and 1 killed; of Mrs. Apolonia Durazo de Langstone, 2 killed and two seriously wounded; of Lorenzo Torres, 1 heifer (two or three years old) wounded, and of Trinidad Durazo, 1 cow killed; that after the Indians had passed on he and his father, by order of the commissary, went out to reconnoiter the vicinity of Nacozari, and discovered the depredations mentioned by him; that the forces then went in the direction of Bacadéhuache. Further, deponent said not.
This testimony being read to him he declared it correct. He did not sign it, being unable to write.
